images.caption: This image was produced by the Auditor's Office in Lucas County, Ohio for tax assessment purposes. Associated dates are approximate. Descriptive terms related to this photograph include: dwelling | on

facade.notes: the Lucas County Auditor block card: a tax-assessment photo with the parcel number in frame: a one-storey gable-front bungalow-cottage with a full-width gabled porch on paired columns, a rock-faced concrete-block foundation and porch base, a gable vent; houses a few feet away on both sides

why.note: rock-faced concrete block, made on site with a hand machine, 1900-1930
